gloss: well-bred; well-raised; from a good family

definitions.gloss: well-bred; well-raised; from a good upbringing
definitions.explanation: Describes someone whose manners, behavior, and character reflect a good upbringing and family background. Implies refinement, politeness, and good values instilled during childhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{育|そだ}ちが{良|い}い。
{言葉遣|ことばづか}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧で、⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|よ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うかがえる→うかがう：01273_ukagau⟧。
examples.english: Their polite way of speaking suggests they were well-raised.

examples.japanese: {育|そだ}ちが{良|い}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧や⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{接|せっ}し→接する：12920_sessuru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: People who are well-raised naturally show refinement in their table manners and how they treat others.

notes:
USAGE:
The opposite expression is ⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (poorly raised). This expression is commonly used when commenting on someone's manners or background, but should be used carefully as it can sound judgmental. The い-adjective form {良|い}い is more common in speech than ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|よ}さ (the quality of one's upbringing)
- {育|そだ}ちが{良|い}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a well-bred person)
- ⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧ (a well-brought-up family)
